name: Qwen2.5-VL-3B
description: Qwen2.5 Vision-Language model for image captioning

prompts.detailed: Describe this image in detail. Focus on the subject, composition, lighting, colors, mood, and any notable elements that would be useful for recreating this image.
prompts.short: Describe this image briefly in one or two sentences.
prompts.tags: List descriptive tags for this image, separated by commas. Include subject, style, mood, colors, and composition.
prompts.analyze: Analyze this image's composition, lighting, color palette, and artistic style. What makes this image visually interesting?

system_prompt: You are an expert image captioner. Generate concise, descriptive captions optimized for image generation prompts. Focus on visual elements, composition, lighting, and style. Be specific and avoid unnecessary words.
